description: This Java source file defines the RenderedViewHierarchy class, which manages a hierarchy of RenderedView objects representing a layout's view tree in Android rendering. It includes methods for creating the hierarchy, querying views by position or tag, and handling included layouts.

classes.name: RenderedViewHierarchy
classes.description: Manages a hierarchy of RenderedView objects representing the layout's view tree, with methods for creation, querying by position or tag, and handling included layouts.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a RenderedViewHierarchy from a PsiFile, list of ViewInfo, and a boolean flag.

methods.name: getRoots
methods.description: Returns the list of root RenderedView objects.

methods.name: getIncludedRoots
methods.description: Returns the list of included root views, if any.

methods.name: findByOffset
methods.description: Finds views corresponding to a specific offset in the source file.

methods.name: findLeafAt
methods.description: Finds the topmost view at given x,y coordinates.

methods.name: findViewByTag
methods.description: Finds a view matching a specific XmlTag.

methods.name: findViewsByTag
methods.description: Finds all views matching a specific XmlTag.
